ops_applied.rationale: Overfull line at 160--162: the first line of item (iv) ends on 'dataset', which has no hyphenation point, so a discretionary hyphen data\-set gives the line a break that fits the measure; the wording is unchanged.

Overfull line at 231--242: the line opens on the citation and closes on the unbreakable highlighted interval '[-300, +250] ms', and a break inside the interval would cut the highlight box, so 'a window of [-300, +250] ms' is reworded to 'a [-300, +250] ms window', same meaning and numbers, which lets the line end on 'window'.

Overfull line at 247--255: the first line of the raw-flattening item ends on 'moving-', and TeX does not hyphenate the part of a compound before its explicit hyphen, so a discretionary mov\-ing gives the line a break that fits; the wording is unchanged.
